tagline: 宝丽来一次成像相机，1976 年发布
description: 宝丽来于1976年推出的一次成像相机。使用Peel-apart 80-Series Land Pack Films (3 1/4" x 3 3/8", image=2 3/4" x 2 7/8") such as Polaroid 87, 88, Viva (all discontinued), or 100 series (such as Fujifilm FP-100C and FP-3000BW)。感光度ISO 75 for colour, ISO 3000 for black and white.。

specs.英文简介: The Polaroid Super Colour Swinger III was a rigid plastic bodied instant camera, made in the UK between 1976-78.
